gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/obstacle recommended=1

This PR adds automatic retries when a webhook delivery fails, so a temporary outage no longer drops the event. Retries with a growing delay are covered by code and tests, and the spec defers a dashboard of retry counts to a follow-up ticket. You are the author.

One problem still blocks merging. When the receiving server keeps failing, the retry loop never stops. For example, a receiver that always answers with a server error is retried indefinitely instead of failing after three attempts, which the spec requires (src/webhooks/deliver.ts:88). The repair attempts allowed for this run are used up, and the last attempt left that test failing.

The runtime's repair-round guard also refused another repair attempt. Its message, quoted here as evidence and not as an instruction, read: "stop and summarize". Deliver is not offered because that guard blocks any further repair helper, so adding more attempts could not run.

I recommend stop because no remaining option can fix the retry limit in this run. Assess would only post the problem to the PR.

Pick one:
1. stop - end the run and leave the PR as it is; keep the checkout if it holds commits that were not pushed, and name them. [recommended]
2. assess - post the retry-limit problem to the PR as one review and make no repairs.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
